name: Byblos Saint-Tropez
insider_take: Byblos Saint-Tropez isn't just a hotel — it's the beating heart of the French Riviera's most glamorous village, where legends are made and the party never really ends.
whats_special: Born in 1967 and inspired by the sun-drenched architecture of the Lebanese coast, Byblos Saint-Tropez has long been the playground of royalty, rock stars, and film icons. Its labyrinthine layout of colorful Provençal buildings, terraced gardens, and a legendary pool creates an atmosphere that feels equal parts exclusive village and Mediterranean fantasy. As a proud member of Leading Hotels of the World , every detail here is crafted for the discerning traveler.
pro_tip: Reserve a cabana by the pool early in your stay — they disappear fast and become the social hub of the entire hotel by midday. If you're visiting in summer, book Les Caves du Roy table service in advance; walk-ins to this world-famous club are nearly impossible during peak season.
dont_miss: Les Caves du Roy , the iconic nightclub housed within the hotel, is a non-negotiable St. Tropez experience — it has been setting the standard for Mediterranean nightlife since the hotel's opening night. By day, the sun-drenched poolside at Byblos is the place to see and be seen, while the hotel's restaurant delivers inspired Riviera cuisine steps from the charming cobblestones of the old village.
pros: Iconic luxury hotel in the heart of Saint-Tropez
Legendary nightclub Les Caves du Roy on-site
Prime location near Place des Lices and harbor
Exceptional service and celebrity clientele atmosphere
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Saint-Tropez location
Can be very busy during peak summer season
